title.narrative: U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention: Emerging and Zoonotic Infectious Diseases

description.narrative: U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), National Center for Emerging and Zoonotic Infectious Diseases (NCEZID) works with partners around the world to prevent illness, disability, and death caused by a wide range of infectious diseases - from the rare but deadly, like anthrax and Ebola, to the more common, like foodborne disease and healthcare-associated infections.
